title: Private open space per apartment: minimum area (Table 1.1a), R10 to R25
text: Primary garden area. C1.1.1 A minimum of one private open space area is provided for the exclusive use of each dwelling, in accordance with Table 1.1a. Table 1.1a Primary garden area provisions. Minimum private open space area (m2 per dwelling): Studio/1 bedroom 8m2; 2 bedrooms 10m2; 3 or more bedrooms 12m2; Ground floor dwelling 15m2. When calculating the extent of private open space for apartments, exclude service areas such as bin storage, clothes drying, air conditioning units and the like.

replaces.note: 10 m2 balcony for all sizes -> Table 1.1a by dwelling size

notes: from: ch3 C1.1.1. diverges: apartments at R10-R25 take the Table 1.1a private open space per apartment (p9) where Chapter 3 grouped dwellings take the OLA by coding (ch3 Table 1.1a). Same test as C1.1.1, separate rule for the different current source. Register C4P1-006 (mixed): current Part B 5.3.1 C1.2 is one balcony of 10 m2 / 2.4 m for every multiple dwelling; studio/1 bed is relaxed to 8 m2 / 2 m, 3+ bed tightened to 12 m2, ground floor 15 m2 / 3 m is new. The Table of Changes says OLA controls continue at R25 and below with minimum size unchanged, which the Chapter 4 Part 1 text does not do (verify). Fact describes the least compliant apartment against Table 1.1a (p9) and its size category (studio_1bed, 2bed, 3bed_plus, ground_floor; proposed fact). Service areas (bin storage, clothes drying, air conditioning units and the like) are excluded from the POS area. Table 1.1a is titled 'Primary garden area provisions', a misnomer for apartments (C4P1-004, C4P1-005).

verified.note: Page applies Table 1.1a to all apartments with no coding split; the Table of Changes statement that OLA controls continue at R25 and below is not reflected on p9.
